title: The Bandwidth Wall
description: How much data one GPU ships per optimizer step: AdamW-DDP vs DeMo's DCT+top-k compression, on a log scale. Toggle OLMo-300M ↔ OLMo-1B, hover a bar for exact MB/step and reduction factor, and slide the link speed to turn megabytes into seconds-per-step. Data: DeMo paper, Table 1 (arXiv:2411.19870).
controls: hover / focus a bar for exact MB/step + reduction
slide link speed to convert MB/step → seconds
